items.q: Can I smoke or vape at Moonshine?
a: Smoking and vaping aren't permitted inside Moonshine.
There is a space directly outside the front of the venue where you're welcome to smoke or vape during your visit.

items.q: Is there a charge to reserve a table?
a: Entry to Moonshine and our regular live entertainment is free, so you're always welcome to join us without a reservation.
If you'd like to guarantee your space, tables can be reserved in advance for a booking fee, giving you guaranteed seating and table service throughout your visit.

items.q: What time do the live music and DJs start?
a: The night builds as we go.
Live performances in the Theatre usually begin between 9pm and 9.30pm, while our DJs typically start from around 8pm and keep things moving throughout the evening.
Come down earlier for a drink, find your table and settle in before the entertainment begins.
Performance times can vary, so take a look at our What's On page for the latest line-up and event details.

items.q: Do I have to pay to see the live entertainment?
a: Our regular live music and entertainment is free to enjoy - simply come in and join us.
Some special events may be ticketed, so always check the individual event listing on our What's On page before visiting.

items.q: Where should I book if I want to watch the live performance?
a: For the best view of the action, book a table in our Theatre.
A Theatre table guarantees you'll be able to see the performance, so you can settle in, order your drinks and enjoy the show from your seat.

items.q: Can I hire a private area for a celebration?
a: Absolutely. Moonshine offers spaces for private hire, whether you're planning a birthday, celebration, party, corporate event or something completely your own.
Head to our Private Hire page and tell us what you have in mind. Our team will be in touch to talk through the possibilities and help bring it together.

items.q: How far is Moonshine from Leicester Railway Station?

items.q: Can I get to Moonshine by bus?
